newsitem.title: POLAND: Merrill lowers Elektrim 1996 eps forecast.
newsitem.headline: Merrill lowers Elektrim 1996 eps forecast.

text.p: Merrill Lynch in London has lowered its 1996 consolidated earnings-per-share forecast for Polish industrial and trading conglomerate Elektrim SA to 1.29 zlotys from 1.46 zlotys, Merrill said in a report.
"This is largely due to higher than predicted consolidated start-up costs of the GSM mobile telecom business which have eroded better than expected cable results," the report dated November 13 said.
PTC Era GSM SA, one of the two companies that obtained a license to operate a digital cellular phone network in Poland, launched services in September. Elektrim holds 32.5 percent. @

Merrill said its revision had not affected its 1997 forecasts, predicting that shareholders would see 30 percent real earnings growth next year fuelled by continued strong performances by Elektrim's cable firms and HCP cement holding.
Merrill said it had raised its 1996 price objective for Elektrim to 28.5 zlotys based on improved cable earnings.

"Accordingly we retain our Accumulate (2) intermediate term recommendation for Elektrim and believe that the company should remain a core holding in any Central European investment portfolio," the report said. @
Elektrim, which has 66.9 million shares outstanding, closed at 26 zlotys on the Warsaw bourse on Monday.
It made a net profit of 32 million zlotys in the first ten months this year and a group net of 77.3 million zlotys last year.
